basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old dance instructor and fitness enthusiast based in Toronto, Canada. I have a deep passion for staying active and promoting a healthy lifestyle. When I'm not teaching dance classes, you can find me hiking the trails around Ontario or experimenting with new healthy recipes. I love sharing tips on sustainable fashion and reselling gently used clothing. Not a fan of fast fashion, I lean towards quality over quantity. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during my lunch breaks. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to explore my personal interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in kinesiology, which I studied during my undergraduate years. My dance and fitness knowledge comes from over a decade of practical teaching experience. Additionally, I've gained insights into the second-hand fashion market through online research and personal selling experiences on platforms like Poshmark and Mercari.
